reading.text:
UNIT def:LevyStochCalc.Driver.LevyDriver -- reading (locked before any Lean)

Paper notion: the standing stochastic basis of sec. 2: on (Omega,F,P), a d-dimensional Brownian
motion W and a Poisson random measure N on R_+ x E with intensity dt nu(de), nu sigma-finite on a
countably generated (E,E), W and N independent, and an independent initial sigma-field F_0; the
filtration (F_t) is the usual augmentation of the filtration generated by W, N and F_0 (so W is an
(F_t)-Brownian motion and N an (F_t)-Poisson random measure). Faithful Lean: a structure bundling
 - W: a d-dimensional (mutually independent coordinates) standard Brownian motion;
 - N: a Poisson random measure: omega |-> a measure on R_+ x E (counting-valued), with N(A)
   Poisson(Leb x nu (A)) for A of finite intensity and N(A_1),...,N(A_k) independent for disjoint
   A_i (independently scattered);
 - independence of W and N (as processes/sigma-algebras), and of both from F_0 (if F_0 is part
   of the driver; a driver with F_0 trivial is a special case = narrower unless F_0 is supplied
   elsewhere);
 - the filtration = the usual augmentation of sigma(F_0, W_s, N((0,s] x A) : s <= t).
nu sigma-finite (infinite activity allowed) is essential -- a structure requiring nu finite
would be narrower than the paper. Harmless representation choices: time index R_{>=0};
countably-generated E encoded as a typeclass or not needed; the filtration as a derived
definition rather than a field (if it is a field, it must be constrained to be that
augmentation, else it is broader and the propositions might hold for a different filtration).

Paper context (sec. 2, sec. 3, sec. 4, App. A). Standing basis: (Omega,F,(F_t),P) satisfying the usual
conditions, horizon T>0, d-dimensional Brownian motion W and an independent Poisson random
measure N on R_+ x E with intensity dt nu(de), nu sigma-finite on a countably generated (E,E);
(F_t) is the usual augmentation of the filtration generated by W, N and an independent initial
sigma-field F_0. Stochastic integrals int Z dW (Z in H^2_W: R^{m x d}-valued predictable,
E int_0^T |Z|_F^2 dt < oo) and int int U dNtilde (U in H^2_N) are the L^2 (Ito /
compensated-Poisson isometry) integrals; they are true L^2 martingales, cadlag, and are used in
identities holding a.s. for every t (sec. 3, "solution"). The paper never constructs these
integrals itself: it takes the standard construction (Applebaum sec. 4, He-Wang-Yan). So every
unit below is infrastructure: the paper's notion is the textbook one, and a faithful Lean
definition is one that (together with the other definitions) yields the textbook object on the
paper's basis for every integrand the paper's claims use; junk values outside that class are
harmless only if every proposition restricts to the class.

comparison.text:
Comparison: def:LevyStochCalc.Driver.LevyDriver (Driver/Joint.lean:50-59)

Reading items -> Lean:
- W: d-dim BM with mutually independent coordinates: YES, W : MultidimBrownianMotion P d
  (unit MultidimBrownianMotion: faithful).
- N: Poisson random measure on R_+ x E with intensity dt x nu, Poisson counts, independent
  scattering: YES, N : PoissonRandomMeasure P nu (intensity referenceIntensity nu =
  Leb|[0,oo) x nu; fields poisson_law, independent_disjoint for countable disjoint families,
  integer_valued, infinite_at_infinite_intensity, joint_past_future_independent).
- nu sigma-finite (infinite activity allowed): YES, [SigmaFinite nu] parameter; nu(E) = oo is
  allowed (no finiteness assumed).
- W independent of N: YES, indep : Indep (sup_i sigmaBrownian (W.W i)) (sigmaPoisson N) P, the
  independence of the whole-process sigma-algebras sigma(W) and sigma(N).
- F_0 independent of both: NOT in the structure; every proposition supplies G_0 with
  h : G_0 <= ambient and hind_0 : Indep G_0 (sup_t D.filtration t) P (68 occurrences in PaperSpec).
  sup_t D.filtration t = sigma(W) ∨ sigma(N) (iSup_sigma_le_iSup_filtration and the reverse
  inclusion), so G_0 ⊥ sigma(W,N) together with W ⊥ N is the mutual independence of F_0, W, N.
- filtration = usual augmentation of sigma(F_0, W, N): NOT a field (good: not a free field); the
  derived LevyDriver.filtration is the raw joint natural filtration, and the paper's (F_t) is
  enlJoint G_0 D h = augFiltration ((D.filtration ⊔ const G_0).rightCont) P, built by consumers.
  W is Brownian and N Poisson for it (isBrownianFiltration_enlJoint, isPoissonFiltration_enlJoint).
- countably generated E: not in the structure; consumers add [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated E].
- d >= 1: not in the structure (d = 0 allowed); consumers add 0 < d where the paper needs it.
Witness: LevyDriver.exists_standardBorel (every d, every sigma-finite nu).
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
Choices: (1) The initial sigma-field F_0 is not part of the driver: each proposition supplies G_0
with Indep G_0 (sup_t D.filtration t) P, and since sup_t D.filtration t = sigma(W) ∨ sigma(N), this
and the field indep give the mutual independence of F_0, W and N. (2) The paper's filtration is not
a field; it is built by consumers as enlJoint (augmentation of the right-continuous version of
D.filtration ⊔ G_0), so the structure cannot carry an unrelated filtration. (3) Countable
generation of E and d >= 1 are hypotheses of the consumers, not of the structure; allowing other
E or d = 0 does not alter the meaning in the paper's case. (4) N lives on R x E with intensity
Lebesgue on [0, oo) times nu, i.e. on R_+ x E.
